text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 52 units of fluorouracil 50mg/mL 20mL SDV at 2.8 units per day, providing 18.3 days on hand. Corvale General holds 56.26 units at the same burn rate, providing 20.3 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage database does not list fluorouracil as in shortage as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately three weeks at both campuses. No national shortage is declared. Supply chain risk remains due to limited manufacturing transparency for some suppliers.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place immediate orders with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (plant last inspected VAI 2023-08-24) and Heritage Pharmaceuticals Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Inc. (plant: Gland Pharma Limited). Requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify ProPharma Distribution and Accord Healthcare, Inc. (plant: Intas Pharmaceuticals Ltd, last inspected OAI 2022-12-02) as secondary sources. Requires Pharmacy Director and Compliance Officer approval.
3. Buyer to request manufacturing site disclosure from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. before qualifying. Requires Compliance Officer approval.
4. Buyer to report weekly inventory and procurement status to P&T Committee until both sites exceed 30 days on hand. Requires P&T Chair acknowledgment.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending shortage listing; relying solely on current stock without qualified backup suppliers.
